plan.notes: NOTE: Dallas College's catalog site (catalog.dallascollege.edu) returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher, so the complete semester-by-semester course sequence was taken from the official Guided Pathways (GPS) page, which the page itself labels 'Catalog Year 2026-2027'. The GPS page states: 'This is not an official degree plan. See the catalog for official degree requirements.' The following are prerequisite courses for MATH 2412.

courses.title: Composition I
courses.choice_note: Must earn a grade of "C" or higher.

courses.title: Learning Framework
courses.choice_note: All college students with fewer than 12 semester credit hours of successful college credit (grade of “C” or above) must take a student success course in the first semester.

courses.title: Pre-Calculus Prerequisites of MATH 1314, and MATH 1316, prior to enrolling in the course.
courses.choice_note: Must earn a grade of "C" or higher.

courses.title: General Chemistry I Prerequisite of MATH 1314, or equivalent academic preparation, prior to enrolling in the course.
Art History II or Theater Appreciation or Music Appreciation

courses.title: Introduction to Physical Fitness and Wellness
World Literature I or Introduction to Philosophy or Introduction to Ethics
courses.choice_note: Choose one: ENGL 2332 — World Literature I; PHIL 1301 — Introduction to Philosophy; PHIL 2306 — Introduction to Ethics
